label: Side Vents + Inner Belt
description: Side vents with an inner martingale belt combine the practical elegance of British double vents with a horizontal half-belt stitched across the back at the waist — the belt is left loose at the centre, adjustable with buttons at each end, allowing the wearer to cinch or release the jacket's waist for a more tailored silhouette. A loose martingale is the more sporting, country-house variant of this detail, found on hacking jackets, tweed coats, and cavalry-inspired tailoring. When cinched, it creates a dramatic waist suppression and clean back that is difficult to achieve through cut alone.
